parameters.name: UserAccessKeyId
parameters.description: The ID of the AccessKey pair that you want to query.

parameters.name: UserPrincipalName
parameters.description:
The logon name of the RAM user.

If you do not specify this parameter, the AccessKey pair of the current user is queried.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ims get-access-key-last-used --user-principal-name test@example.onaliyun.com --user-access-key-id LTAI0000000000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
